matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 351-360 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages match the current extraction and no new correction is needed. Page 358 retains its earlier complete visual review after correction and is intentionally omitted from this bundle's matching-page list so that prior disposition remains authoritative on replay.
